“and We paired them with wide-eyed ones [bi-is in]”

Three explanations transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 52:20).

910
Explanation from Sufyān No. 910: 1: 5

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
910: 1:5. Sufyan said: In the reading of Abd Allah:
"and We paired them with wide-eyed ones [bi-is in]" (verse 20).
العربية
910: 1: 5 سفيان قَالَ فِي قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وزوجناهم بعيس عين (الآية 20) .
